message.content:
The question asks for resolutions that drive changes to spec 38.331. Resolutions reference CRs/Tdocs, which modify specs. The ordering keys (meetingNumberInt, agendaNumber, sequence) suggest joining through meetings and agenda items.

A Resolution connects to specs via REFERENCES → CR/Tdoc → MODIFIES → Spec.

```json
{"query":"SELECT r.resolutionId AS resolutionId FROM Resolution r JOIN rel_REFERENCES ref ON ref.src_id=r.node_id JOIN rel_MODIFIES m ON m.src_id=ref.dst_id JOIN Spec s ON s.node_id=m.dst_id LEFT JOIN rel_MADE_AT ma ON ma.src_id=r.node_id LEFT JOIN Meeting mt ON mt.node_id=ma.dst_id LEFT JOIN rel_RESOLUTION_BELONGS_TO rb ON rb.src_id=r.node_id LEFT JOIN AgendaItem ai ON ai.node_id=rb.dst_id WHERE s.specNumber='38.331' GROUP BY r.node_id ORDER BY CAST(MAX(mt.meetingNumberInt) AS INTEGER) DESC, MIN(ai.agendaNumber) ASC, MIN(r.sequence) ASC LIMIT 10","abstain":false}
```
